# czc-v2026.10.24.3 (0.2.17.29)

User channel-status cards show the group multiplier as `1.2x` in red.

## Changes since czc-v2026.10.24.2

### Channel-status card rate

- The highlighted multiplier uses a trailing `x` (`1.2x`, `1x`, `0.8x`).
- The rate is extra-bold red (`text-red-600` / `text-red-400` in dark
  mode).
- A user-specific rate still strikes through the group default and
  highlights the custom value.

## VERSION

`0.2.17.29`

## Upgrade guidance

Drop-in. No database migration and no configuration change.

## Compatibility

- Billing, probe routing, and V1/V2 monitor mode are unchanged.
- Peak-rate window text next to the multiplier is unchanged.
- V2 matrix row labels are unchanged.

## Rollback

Redeploy `czc-v2026.10.24.2`, or restore the backup
`/opt/sub2api/sub2api.bak.czc-v2026.10.24.3-<UTC timestamp>` created
during this deploy and restart `sub2api.service`. Rolling back restores
the previous `×1.00` primary-colored rate. Probe monitors and billing
are unchanged.
